entities.summary: Singapore is a sovereign nation in Southeast Asia, Asia. Its capital is Singapore (city-state). Official languages include English, Mandarin Chinese, Malay. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 6.0 million. Area: 734.3 km². Comprehensive index for Singapore covering Temasek/Singapura (Sang Nila Utama legend), Srivijaya/Majapahit, Portuguese raid 1613, Johor Sultanate, Stamford Raffles founding 1819, British Straits Settlements, WWII Japanese occupation (Sook Ching massacre), merger with Malaysia 1963, expulsion 1965, Lee Kuan Yew's authoritarian modernization, economic miracle (entrepot to high-tech), PAP dominance, and city-state governance.
